# Gemmer danske aktier på gyldne muligheder?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish episode of Euroinvestor's Millionærklub. Guests from Fundamental Invest argue that Danish equities now trade at an unusually large discount after years out of favour. They make a strong case for ChemoMetec, their largest position at about 10%, built on its new partnership with Roche, and also like Vestas on improving margins and a cheap valuation. Regular panelist Lars Svendsen is cautiously upbeat on real assets and a European recovery, and holds DFDS as a turnaround case.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CHEMM — ChemoMetec | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 90%

Largest position (~10%). Roche partnership makes XM30 the natural replacement for Roche's cell counter; consensus does not reflect this upside.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Fundamental Invest). Over 90% gross margin, over 50% EBIT margin and recurring consumables. 3,000-10,000 units to replace by 2029 at ~$160-200k each could mean ~DKK 3bn vs ~DKK 500m annual sales today. The letter of intent is now a formal partnership. 25x EBITDA vs BioLife's 50-55x deal multiple. Guidance of +15% or more on Thursday would be positive. Svendsen likes the company but notes past delays.

#### Sell Triggers

- cautious or low guidance in the FY report
- Roche partnership fails to convert into orders
- Beckman Coulter or another competitor finds a compatible replacement
- further order delays

> *"jeg synes, at det er et af de mest spændende muligheder, jeg har set i de 57 år, jeg har handlet aktier"*

---

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Pricing discipline, strong US and German onshore orders, service margin recovery and offshore near break-even; 10x 2027 EV/EBIT.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Consolidated four-player market, Chinese makers absent in the West, new competent CFO. Service EBIT margin heading back toward 20%. Vestas could hit a 10% EBIT margin in 2027, above consensus. They added shares on the ~20% drop after the CEO's share sale.

#### Sell Triggers

- service margin stops improving
- offshore scale-up stays loss-making
- US orders dry up

> *"Og når den så handler EV-EBIT på 10 gange her i 2027, jamen så synes vi, det er billigt og attraktivt at være med på."*

---

### 🟡 DFDS — DFDS | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen holds a fair position but won't add. The turnaround needs a new CEO grip, lower debt and a fix for land transport, taking 3-4 years.

#### Reasoning

Panelist Lars Svendsen's view. The company overexpanded, has overcapacity, ~DKK 16-17bn debt and logistics running at zero. A board shake-up led by Lauritzen and a new CEO could help, and an economic upturn or Ukraine rebuilding would benefit the company.

#### Sell Triggers

- new CEO fails to cut debt or fix logistics
- no economic upturn

> *"jeg er jo til knæet, og jeg kan ikke sige, at jeg skal have mere"*

---

### 🟡 RTX — RTX | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Big 2025 winner that guests believe will keep running.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Michael Foss), stated briefly: RTX has delivered a lot and they believe the move continues. No details were given.

> *"Til gengæld har vi haft rigtig meget glæde I 2025 af RTX Som vi tror kører videre"*

---

### 🟢 GRLA — Grønlandsbanken | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Svendsen's stock-game buy on Greenland geopolitics and EU/US funding pledges.

#### Reasoning

Panelist Lars Svendsen's view. A speculative bet that competition between the EU and the US for Greenland brings funding (EU pledged DKK 1.5bn) the market has overlooked. This is a stock-game position, not a core portfolio holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- geopolitical interest in Greenland fades

> *"jeg tænkte, jeg ville være lidt kæk, og så købe nogle Grønlandsbanken"*

---
